subject.title: fix: keep owner tools available in WebChat

question: Should authenticated internal WebChat owners bypass the wildcard `toolsBySender` policy even though some existing configs may have used `"*"` to restrict all WebChat turns?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it changes the security meaning of an existing config wildcard for owner-authenticated WebChat, so automation should not silently decide operator intent.

options.title: Accept owner-WebChat bypass
options.body: Treat wildcard sender policy as external/unidentified-sender policy and land this PR after exact-head gates are green.

options.title: Require a narrower contract
options.body: Ask for docs or a no-sender-only guard if maintainers want identified WebChat clients to remain configurable through explicit sender policies.

options.title: Keep wildcard semantics
options.body: Pause or revise the PR if `toolsBySender["*"]` must continue restricting authenticated owner WebChat turns by default.

recommendation.title: Accept owner-WebChat bypass
recommendation.body: Treat wildcard sender policy as external/unidentified-sender policy and land this PR after exact-head gates are green.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa introduced the shared capability-profile and harness paths that now define this policy boundary.
